name: Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela - Après le § 50 - Am 107
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 50a. Calls for further streamlining of the Union’s administrative services in order to eliminate duplication and reduce unnecessary costs; emphasises that the savings thus achieved should be reallocated to priorities that provide tangible added value to citizens, in particular agriculture, border security, support for SMEs, and research and innovation;
